input.quote: 13.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier pursuant to this Article 13, shall continue in full force and effect, on a Product-by-Product and country-by-country basis until the Secondary Royalty Term with respect to such Product expires, at which time this Agreement shall expire in its entirety with respect to such Product in such country.
input.rationale: This is a license/development agreement with no auto-renewing subscription term. Section 13.1 sets a single term running on a Product-by-Product, country-by-country basis until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term, after which the Agreement expires and Ono's licenses become perpetual, fully paid-up and royalty-free — there is no automatic renewal, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic to cap. Section 14.4 expressly confirms that continued dealing after expiry is not a renewal or extension. Ono also holds a unilateral right to terminate without cause on notice under Section 13.2. The renewal-exit and price-predictability concerns behind this rule therefore do not arise, and the outcome is at least as favourable to us as the preferred position; nothing to redline.
